records.text:
ChatGPT is leading AI search today.
Google AI Mode could soon become the default search experience for millions more people.

So we wanted to know: how differently do they actually see brands?

We compared both platforms across 22 categories, looking at the brands they mention, the sources they cite, and the patterns behind those answers.

What we found:

→ 69% of the most-mentioned brands overlap
→ But the source mix looks very different
→ Being mentioned doesn’t always mean being cited
→ Brands show up alongside a clear consideration set
→ And every category has its own Citation Core

Read the full AI Visibility Index Mini Study for the complete breakdown ↓
Link in bio.
